import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()

    species_map = {
        "Gentoo": "Gentoo",
        "Gentoo ": "Gentoo",
        "adelie": "Adelie",
        "Adelie": "Adelie",
        "Adeile": "Adelie",
        "Gentto": "Gentoo",
        "Chinstrap": "Chinstrap",
        "Chinstarp": "Chinstrap",
        "Chinstrap ": "Chinstrap",
    }
    df["species"] = df["species"].map(species_map)

    df["body_mass_g"] = (df["body_mass_g"].astype(str)
                         .str.replace("", "", regex=False)
                         .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
                         .astype(float))

    return df

def answer(df):
    result = {}
    grouped = df.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].sum()
    for species, total in grouped.items():
        if pd.notna(species):
            result[species] = total
    return result
